_comment: Scope: MMC does FOOTBALL commentary only. Racing channels (horses-*,
greyhounds-*) are another provider's output and are listed here disabled,
purely so nobody re-discovers them and assumes they were missed.
The platform carries ~120 channels; these are the football channels seen
broadcasting during discovery. NARROW THIS TO MMC'S OWN CHANNELS - some of
these belong to other providers, and alerting on their commentators is
noise nobody at MMC can act on.
Claimed channels (picked by a commentator on the web page) are monitored
too, whether or not they are listed here. This list is only what is watched
even when nobody has claimed it.
Thresholds live in src/commentary_qc/config.py (set 2026-09-10 from the
listening tests): quiet below -40 LUFS over a minute (clears above -37),
'thresholds' here overrides those defaults for one channel only.
